description: Only the filings of the watched form changed since your cursor (delta of /v1/edg. Keyset delta of /v1/edgar/watch/:form: pass since=<next_cursor from your last call> and get only the filings of the watched form added or changed after it, plus changed_count and a new next_cursor. Omit since once to bootstrap. Cursors are stable across restarts. Poll the free sibling /v1/edgar/watch/:form/changes for counts and pay only when there is something to fetch.
